t: 教宗格里高利十一世在决定从阿维尼翁迁回罗马后到达了罗马.
te: Pope Gregory XI reaches Rome, after deciding to move the Papacy back to Rome from Avignon.
dz: 教宗格里高利十一世在决定从阿维尼翁迁回罗马后到达了罗马.
de: Pope Gregory XI reaches Rome, after deciding to move the Papacy back to Rome from Avignon.

t: 教宗格里高利十一世出出五道教宗公牛来谴责英国神学家约翰·威克利夫的教义.
te: Pope Gregory XI issues five papal bulls to denounce the doctrines of English theologian John Wycliffe.
dz: 教宗格里高利十一世出出五道教宗公牛来谴责英国神学家约翰·威克利夫的教义.
de: Pope Gregory XI issues five papal bulls to denounce the doctrines of English theologian John Wycliffe.

t: 英国国王理查二世加冕。
te: King Richard II of England is crowned.
dz: 英国国王理查二世加冕。
de: King Richard II of England is crowned.

t: 俄国军队被蓝色霍尔德汗阿拉普沙部队在平亚纳河战役中击败.
te: Russian troops are defeated by forces of the Blue Horde Khan Arapsha in the Battle on Pyana River.
dz: 俄国军队被蓝色霍尔德汗阿拉普沙部队在平亚纳河战役中击败.
de: Russian troops are defeated by forces of the Blue Horde Khan Arapsha in the Battle on Pyana River.

t: 安德罗尼科斯四世·帕拉伊洛戈斯和他年幼的儿子约翰被君士坦丁堡的保皇党人马卡里乌斯加冕.
te: Andronikos IV Palaiologos and his young son John are crowned by patriarch Macarius of Constantinople.
dz: 安德罗尼科斯四世·帕拉伊洛戈斯和他年幼的儿子约翰被君士坦丁堡的保皇党人马卡里乌斯加冕.
de: Andronikos IV Palaiologos and his young son John are crowned by patriarch Macarius of Constantinople.

t: Tvrtko一世被加冕为波斯尼亚第一任国王.
te: Tvrtko I is crowned the first king of Bosnia.
dz: Tvrtko一世被加冕为波斯尼亚第一任国王.
de: Tvrtko I is crowned the first king of Bosnia.
